_comment: Fields that are identical in every language. push_metadata.py merges this
under each metadata_<locale>.json, so a locale file carries only the text
a translator actually touched. Change a URL here, not in fifty places.
name is the app's name and is deliberately not translated: it is a bird,
and the App Store shows one name per listing. whatsNew is rejected on an
app that has never been released, and the push script drops it if Apple
reviewNotes lives in metadata_en_GB.json alone — App Review reads the
primary locale, and the reviewer unlock code must not be repeated fifty
name: Wren
whatsNew:
Sharing is smoother. After you share a reel or a post, a notification appears — tap it to open Wren straight away. No more hunting for the app on your Home Screen.

Large video reels that could not be read before now work.
_privacyPolicyUrl: Required, and its absence is not obvious: the version simply refuses to
enter review with 'this resource cannot be reviewed', and only the nested
associatedErrors name privacyPolicyUrl. It lives on appInfoLocalizations,
beside name and subtitle, not on the version.
